get_subaccounts_for_account.description: List the sub-accounts under a customer account: SubAccountUid/Id, products enabled, active flag. Active 0=inactive/1=active; product families CA=Chat Apps, SM=SMS, VI=Video, VO=Voice, V8=Verify. DEV (AppDb_dev).

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: Optional portal user id (GUID). Omit (null) to return all sub-accounts on the account.

get_subaccount.description: Get one sub-account's details/settings. Active 0/1; ProtectionStatusId 0=Disabled/1=Monitoring/2=Alerts; MsgProcessingFlags OR-bitmask 1=DrReceived,2=DrSent,4=DrDeliveredToCarrier,8=FinalDr,16=OptOutMo. DEV (AppDb_dev).

get_account_balance.description: Current pre-paid billing balance for an account, in the account's currency. DEV (AppDb_dev).

get_channels_config.description: Chat-apps/the messaging channel config for an account. ChannelTypeId: 0/13=SMS,1=the messaging channel,2=Facebook,3=RCS,4=AppleBusinessChat,5=Viber,6=Line,7=WeChat,8=Zalo,9=Kakao,10=ZaloNotification,11=Instagram,12=LineNotification,14=Call,15=Mock. Channel status A=Active,D=Deployment,F=Failed,M=Migration,P=Pending,R=Rejected,S=Stopped,V=Validation. the messaging channel template status 1=Approved,2=Pending,3=Rejected,4=Pending deletion,5=Deleted,6=In appeal,7=Disabled,8=Paused; category 14=UTILITY,15=AUTHENTICATION,16=MARKETING. DEV (AppDb_dev).

id_search_sms.description: Search SMS in DEV within an account + time window. Account- and timeframe-SCOPED: AccountUid, UserId, TimeframeStart, TimeframeEnd are ALL required; pass UMID to narrow to one message. Decode StatusId 10-level model (0=UNKNOWN..20=SENT..40=DELIVERED..50=READ); SmsTypeId 0=MO,1=MT,2=RCS_MO,3=RCS_MT_TEXT,4=RCS_MT_MEDIA. Backed by core.MessageLog_SearchByFilter_v5. NOTE: v5 has NO MaskSensitiveData param, so results are unmasked — DEV test data only. DEV (AppDb_dev).

parameters.name: AccountUid
parameters.description: Customer account to search within (GUID). REQUIRED.

parameters.name: UserId
parameters.description: Portal user id (GUID) scoping accessible sub-accounts. REQUIRED.

parameters.name: TimeframeStart
parameters.description: Start of window (UTC datetime, ISO 8601). REQUIRED. Keep it tight — the cloud data warehouse scan.

parameters.name: TimeframeEnd
parameters.description: End of window (UTC datetime, ISO 8601). REQUIRED.

parameters.name: UMID
parameters.description: Optional: narrow to a single message id (GUID).

id_lookup_sms_region_by_umid.description: Resolve which region a UMID belongs to (fast router lookup; RegionName only, no body). DEV (AppDb_dev).

parameters.name: Umid
parameters.description: Unique message id (GUID) to resolve. Required.

parameters.name: ConnUid
parameters.description: Alternate key (connection uid); the SP requires it but ignores it when Umid is set, so a dummy 0 is passed.

parameters.name: CorrelationId
parameters.description: Alternate key (connector message id); the SP requires it but ignores it when Umid is set, so an empty string is passed.
